label: MikroTik: Validate RSC syntax (local only, no device)
args:
import pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
if not p.is_file():
    print(f'error: file not found: {p}', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
n = p.stat().st_size
if n == 0:
    print(f'error: file is empty: {p}', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
if n > 5242880:
    print(f'error: file too large (>5MiB): {n} bytes', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
try:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
except Exception as exc:
    print(f'error: unreadable as UTF-8: {exc}', file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
lines = text.count(chr(10)) + (0 if text.endswith(chr(10)) else 1)
print(f'Validate OK: {p.name} ({n} bytes, {lines} lines, UTF-8) - semantic checks come from rsc-ls diagnostics; use Check script for a deploy preview.')

label: MikroTik: Live — Enable enrichment (set RSC_LS_LIVE=1)
args: Set env RSC_LS_LIVE=1 MIKROTIK_HOST=... MIKROTIK_PASS=... and restart Zed. Live enrichment is in-memory only, never touches data/commands.toml. Pass via env/keychain only — never stored in tasks.json. See lsp/src/live.rs for caps/TTL.
